Mrs. Aplin, sister of the late Frank Elson, presented the "Frank Elson" Cup to Ray Middleton (52:56) at the Club '7' Track Walk Championship and donated the handicap prize which was won by Herbert Hooper.
Both John and Ray were off the same mark in the handicap and they won first and second prizes respectively with Bert East taking third place. The prizes were presented by Mrs.

We acknowledge the kindness of Mrs Aplin, sister of our former late President Frank Elson, in presenting a special miniature cup to Ray Middleton for winning the Club 7 miles Track Walk Championship on three successive occasions.

They earned £40 for the Club with their efforts and this will be spent on a vaulting pole and javelins suitable for use by the youngsters. One who never misses the Club 10,000m Walk Championship is MRS. APLIN, and again we were pleased to see her at Battersea Park on May 1st.

This list includes those who gave to the championship medal fund and also the last Merton Show bottle stall. Mrs.

We are sorry to learn of the death of Ernest "George" Aplin during a spell in hospital following an operation. With Mrs. Aplin (sister of the late Frank Elson) he was a loyal supporter, particularly of walking events.

Once again Mrs. Aplin braved the elements (you always have to for this event) to attend the Club 10,000 metres Track Walking Championship, and once more we have to thank her for donating a handicap prize and presenting the awards.
Thanks are due once again to Mrs. Aplin for giving the handicap prize and presenting the cup and medals.
We are indebted to Mrs. Aplin, Frank Elson's sister, and Don Brown for two more Club Trophies.
